name: Phase 1 starter watchlist
notes: Two benchmarks first — SPY for the broad market, QQQ for tech/growth — so a move on a single name can be read against the tape rather than in isolation. Both are required by Phase 1 and a test asserts they are present. Then seven liquid mega-cap tech names, which is also where the index concentration actually sits, and two reads on what tech alone will not show you: JPM for rates and credit, XLE for geopolitics. Edit the names freely; leave SPY and QQQ alone.
